splash.title: Stay calm!
splash.subtitle: This portal works offline and helps you in crisis and emergency situations. You can call emergency numbers with your mobile network (4G/5G).

guides.title: Cardiac arrest
guides.content:
Protocol:
  • 1️⃣ Secure area, call 15/112
  • 2️⃣ Check consciousness/breathing (10s)
  • 3️⃣ If unconscious and not breathing: 30 compressions (100-120/min, 5-6cm deep)
  • 4️⃣ Use AED as soon as possible
  • 5️⃣ Alternate 30:2 if trained

Never interrupt compressions unnecessarily.

guides.title: Recovery position
guides.content:
For an unconscious person who is breathing:
  • 👉 Place the victim's arm at a right angle
  • 👉 Bring the other arm across the chest
  • 👉 Bend the opposite knee
  • 👉 Roll the victim onto their side while supporting the head
  • 👉 Tilt the head to open the airway
  • ✅ Call 15, monitor breathing until help arrives

guides.title: Epilepsy
guides.content:
What to do:
  • ✅ Protect the head (pillow, clothing)
  • ✅ Remove dangerous objects
  • ❌ Do not put anything in the mouth
  • ❌ Do not restrict movements
  • ⏱️ Call 15 if: first seizure, duration >5 min, injury, breathing difficulty
  • After seizure, place in recovery position

guides.title: Bleeding
guides.content:
Stop severe bleeding:
  • 🔴 Apply direct pressure with a clean cloth
  • 🔴 Maintain firm pressure, do not release
  • 🔴 If blood soaks through, add another cloth without removing the first
  • 🔴 Lay the victim down, call 15
  • ⚠️ Tourniquet only as a last resort by a professional

guides.title: Choking
guides.content:
Adult:
  • Encourage coughing
  • 5 back blows
  • 5 abdominal thrusts (fist above navel, push inward and upward)
  • Alternate until expulsion or loss of consciousness
  • If unconscious: begin CPR

guides.title: Fire
guides.content:
Rules:
  • ❌ Do not use elevators
  • ✅ Stay low to avoid smoke (crawl)
  • ✅ Close doors behind you
  • ✅ If clothes on fire: STOP - DROP - ROLL
  • ✅ Call firefighters (18/112) from a safe place

guides.title: AED
guides.content:
Defibrillator:
  • 1️⃣ Turn on the device
  • 2️⃣ Follow voice instructions
  • 3️⃣ Expose chest, place pads as shown
  • 4️⃣ Do not touch the victim during analysis
  • 5️⃣ If shock advised: clear the area and press the button
  • 6️⃣ Resume compressions immediately

guides.title: Severe allergy
guides.content:
Signs: swelling, hives, difficulty breathing, fainting.
Action:
  • ✅ Lay the victim down (or semi-sitting if breathing difficulty)
  • ✅ Use an auto-injector if available (e.g., EpiPen)
  • ✅ Call 15 immediately
  • ❌ Do not give anything to drink or eat

guides.title: Hypoglycemia
guides.content:
Symptoms: sweating, weakness, confusion, paleness.
Action:
  • If conscious and can swallow: give sugar (sweet drink, 2 sugar cubes, fruit juice)
  • Improvement within 5-10 min
  • If unconscious: recovery position, call 15, do not give anything by mouth
  • If known diabetic: look for a glucometer

guides.title: Attack
guides.content:
International protocol: Run, Hide, Tell
  • 🏃‍♂️ Run if possible, do not run in a group, leave the area
  • 🚪 Hide: lock door, turn off lights, stay out of sight, silence phone
  • 📞 Tell police (17) only when safe, describe the situation
  • ❌ Do not approach security forces with hands in pockets
  • ✅ Apply first aid after the area is secured

guides.title: Drowning
guides.content:
Action:
  • 🆘 Remove the victim from water quickly
  • ✅ Check consciousness and breathing
  • ❌ Do not attempt to drain water from lungs (useless and dangerous)
  • 💨 If not breathing: start CPR (30 compressions / 2 breaths)
  • 📞 Call 15 or 112, use an AED if available
  • 🩱 Cover the victim to prevent hypothermia

guides.title: Calling 15/112
guides.content:
Key information:
  • 📍 Exact location (address, floor, access point)
  • 👥 Number of victims
  • 🩺 Condition: conscious? breathing? bleeding?
  • ⚡ Event: accident, illness, fire...
  • 📞 Do not hang up first, follow instructions
  • 📱 Use speakerphone if possible

mental.title: Heart coherence
mental.content:
5-5-5 breathing:
Inhale 5s, exhale 5s, pause 5s. Repeat for 5 minutes. Immediate calming effect.

mental.title: Anxiety 3-3-3
mental.content:
Grounding technique:
Name 3 things you see, 3 sounds you hear, move 3 parts of your body.

mental.title: Burnout prevention
mental.content: Signs: exhaustion, cynicism, inefficiency. Take breaks, exercise, seek help.

mental.title: Quick meditation
mental.content: Sit comfortably, focus on your breath. Let thoughts pass without judgment.

mental.title: Suicide prevention
mental.content: If you have suicidal thoughts: call 3114 (24/7, anonymous). You are not alone, help is available.

mental.title: Art therapy
mental.content: Exercise: Draw or write what you feel without judgment. Creative expression reduces stress and anxiety.

mental.title: Mindful walking
mental.content: Walk slowly, focus on each step, the feeling of the ground, your breath. 10 minutes a day improves mood.

mental.title: Gratitude journal
mental.content: Each evening, note 3 small positive things from the day. This practice builds psychological resilience.

mental.title: Managing rumination
mental.content: STOP technique: Stop (say STOP mentally), Breathe, Observe your sensations, Proceed with a constructive action.

mental.title: Support groups
mental.content: Join support groups (associations, youth centers). Sharing experiences eases suffering.
